manaNeeded: {9}{C}{C}{C} the first turn, with {11}{C}{C}{C} available each extra turn
notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Kess's ability this turn if Rise of the Eldrazi is in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Rise of the Eldrazi either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {9}{C}{C}{C}, causing target player to draw four cards, and you to destroy target permanent, take an extra turn after this one and exile Rise of the Eldrazi.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Pull from Eternity copy, putting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard from exile.
Repeat.
